name: Ship of Dreams
source:
Your wealthy family expects you to find a match aboard the RMS Titanic, but they'd never approve of the lowly engine worker who steals your heart.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Ship_of_Dreams]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你富有的家人希望你能在泰坦尼克号上找到匹配的人，但他们永远不会赞成偷走你心的卑微轮机工人。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Ship_of_Dreams]Choices Wikia[/url]]
